text: Entries 1158–1161 recover a reported build break by annotating runtime global initialization. The 1159 message explicitly calls this a stopgap and says many globals should be removed. Accepted source now uses constinit for gBootstrap and localized folder strings, StaticRefPtr for the compaction observer, and StaticAutoPtr for view strings. Retained runtime annotations in other files do not justify a rule to add MOZ_RUNINIT to every new global. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: Treat the global constructor annotations as a build recovery step
